text:
Claire (People Ops): FYI new hire Theo Lin starts Tue 11/11. Need I-9 check, badge photo, laptop imaging, and benefits email. Can someone handle reception handoff?
Maya (Hiring): I can meet him at reception 08:50. He said he'll bring passport. If not, what's fallback?
Claire (People Ops): Passport preferred. If he brings DL + SS card that's OK too. We can schedule remote verifier same day at 15:30 if originals are missing. Note: mark HRIS 'I-9 pending' if remote.
it-bot: Imaging slot 09:10-09:30 reserved. MacBook Pro 14" assigned. MDM enrollment will auto-run on first boot.
bg-bot: Background check link sent to theo.lin@redwood.ai  status: pending consent. Reminder in 6h.
Ravi (Facilities): I'll print a temporary badge and take a quick photo at check-in. Permanent badge issued after BG clear.
Maya (Hiring): Also planning a short team intro lunch at 12:30, small group. Is catering allowed?
Claire (People Ops): Yes light lunch ok. I'll approve up to $50. Please RSVP headcount by 10:00.
it-bot: I'll leave a USB-C dongle and ethernet adapter in the sleeve. Laptop will be labeled "Theo L".
Claire (People Ops): Action items: 1) Maya meet at 08:50 2) Ravi temp badge/photo + upload to ticket 3) IT imaging 09:10 4) Send day-1 checklist & benefits link to candidate.
Maya (Hiring): Thanks all. Theo, welcome :tada: — I'll see you at reception.
